verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list prefix caching as a built-in engine feature, next to continuous batching and chunked prefill, and its PagedAttention KV-cache management underpins it. The evidence is only a single feature-list line, though. Community comments praise KV caching in general but do not mention prefix caching specifically. missing for 10: dedicated prefix-caching docs (how to enable or configure it, cache eviction behavior), benchmarks showing speedups on repeated-prompt workloads, independent hands-on corroboration of prefix caching specifically

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching
